thread:
elaine_sales: Quick help please — AcmeCorp POC needs SIG v2 evidence. They want encryption-at-rest proof, KMS details, SOC2 mapping, and subprocessors. Deadline: EOD Wed. Link to questionnaire: https://acme.sig.example.com/respond/abc123

sam_security: Copy. Which exact questions are blocking the deal? list a few question numbers and I’ll prioritize.

mike_se: I can carve up docs: architecture diagram (png), config snippets (nginx/tls, storage), and a short runbook for key rotation. Where should I upload?

elaine_sales: Prefer signed PDFs in secure upload. Use the secure bucket: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/sig/acme-1769754321 or Box link (shared with Acme sec team). Please put each question's evidence in its own folder.

sam_security: Got it. I’ll start with encryption (Q14, Q15). Planned uploads: KMS policy (signed), redacted audit logs for last 90 days, config showing AES256 at rest, and the SOC2 mapping matrix.

tina_custsec: Quick Q from Acme: who holds the KMS keys for Hosted API? They asked if Redwood has any access to plaintext for hosted customers.

sam_security: Short answer: for Hosted API we manage the service keys by default (Redwood-managed KMS). We offer customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated/Private. We do NOT have access to customer plaintext for BYOK when configured. I’ll add a one-page explainer and a config snippet.

mike_se: Example snippet I’ll include for BYOK (redacted):
```
# example: enable customer KMS in config.yaml
storage:
  encryption: aes256
  kms_provider: aws_kms
  kms_key_id: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/xxxx-xxxx"
```

sam_security: Upload plan ETA: 4 hours. I’ll redact PII from logs and attach SHA256 checksums. Legal_bot: can you confirm the NDA covers relaying redacted audit logs to Acme?

legal_bot: NDA check done — sharing redacted logs and architectural diagrams is allowed. Do not include customer PII or cross-tenant data. Mark files: "For Acme SIG" in the metadata.

elaine_sales: Thanks. Also Acme asked for subprocessors list and a completed CAIQ extract for their vendor risk tool. Can someone generate a CSV of subprocessors and Tx timestamp?

mike_se: I’ll pull the current subprocessors list from infra-ops and output CSV. Will add our SOC2 control IDs as a column so they can map.

sam_security: Uploading now: 1769754321-evidence-encryption.zip -> s3://redwood-sec-evidence/sig/acme-1769754321/encryption.zip (contains kms-policy.pdf, aes-config.txt, redacted-audit-logs.pdf). SHA256: 3f2a...

deploy-bot: File upload complete: encryption.zip (signed), size 1.2MB. Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-sec-evidence/sig/acme-1769754321/encryption.zip

tina_custsec: Received links, thanks. Two quick follow-ups: 1) Can you share the key rotation cadence? 2) Is there an incident response SLA for data exfil?

sam_security: Rotation cadence: default 365 days for service keys; customers can set custom rotation for BYOK. IR SLA: see incident response summary (we commit to initial response acknowledgement within 1 hour for severity 1 incidents; full report within 72 hours). I’ll attach the IR summary pdf.

mike_se: Uploaded subprocessors.csv and caiq-extract.csv to same bucket. Also added a short README mapping SIG questions -> evidence filenames.

elaine_sales: Perfect. I’ll forward the link to Acme and update the CRM. Next action: Sam, can you add the SOC2 mapping spreadsheet to the same folder before EOD Wed? That completes the packet.

sam_security: Will do — adding SOC2 mapping in 1 hour.

elaine_sales: Awesome — thanks everyone :raised_hands: I’ll ping if Acme needs anything else.
